response.text:
Indian winters mein skin ka moisture tezi se kam hota hai, isliye aisi cream ya lotion chunna zaroori hai jo skin barrier ko repair kare aur long-lasting hydration de.[www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/top-body-moisturizers-for-dry-skin-relief-in-winters.html#:~:text=Specifically%20formulated%20for%20sensitive%20skin%2C%20Cetaphil%20Restoraderm,Bright%20Healthy%20Radiance%20Brightening%20Night%20Comfort%20Cream.)

Neeche kuch best options diye gaye hain jo dry skin ke liye bahut acche maane jaate hain:

Cetaphil DAM skin ke liye ek behtareen choice hai kyunki yeh **shea butter aur 9 moisturizers** se enriched hai, jo dry skin ko **48 hours tak hydration** dete hain.[www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/top-body-moisturizers-for-dry-skin-relief-in-winters.html#:~:text=Daily%20Advance%20Ultra%20Hydrating%20Lotion%20is%20perfect,up%20with%20a%20refreshed%20and%20hydrated%20complexion.)

Yeh lotion **coconut milk aur cocoa butter** ki goodness ke sath aata hai, jo harsh winters mein bhi dry aur flaking skin ko **deeply nourish aur repair** karta hai.

Yeh non-greasy formula **Vaseline jelly aur micro-droplets** ke sath skin mein deeply penetrate karta hai, aur moisture ko **lock karke skin ko soft** banata hai.[www.livelyskinco.com](https://www.livelyskinco.com/best-moisturizer-for-dry-skin-in-india/#:~:text=Milk%20%E2%80%93%20The%20top%20layer%20of%20the,any%20kind%20of%20skin%20problem%20in%20adults.)

Agar face ke liye light weight cream chahiye toh yeh **rice water, niacinamide, aur shea butter** ka blend skin ko **24-hour nourishment aur dewy glass-skin glow** deta hai.
